brief_description: Decompose a flat ad image into editable layers (background, product/logo cutouts, live text, vector shapes) as a structured JSON document
detailed_description:
# BRIA Ads Delayer API Documentation

## Overview

BRIA Ads Delayer decomposes a flat ad image into an editable, structured JSON layer document — a background plate, product and logo cutouts, live text with typography, and vector shapes. It is trained exclusively on licensed data. Latency is on average under one minute. Input is assumed to be a flat ad; ordinary photographs are out of scope.

## Authentication

All API requests require authentication using your API key. Include it in the Authorization header:

``
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
``

## Submit Delayer Request

### Base URL

``
https://console.gmicloud.ai
``

### Endpoint

``
POST /api/v1/ie/requestqueue/apikey/requests
``

### Request Format

``
curl -X POST "https://console.gmicloud.ai/api/v1/ie/requestqueue/apikey/requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "bria-ads-delayer",
    "payload": {
      "attachments": ["https://example.com/summer_sale_ad.jpg"],
      "text_mode": "font"
    }
  }'
``

## Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `attachments` | image | Yes | Exactly one flat ad image (URL or Base64-encoded JPEG/PNG/WEBP), up to 10 MB and 800px per dimension (enterprise accounts have no dimension cap). | — |
| `text_mode` | enum | No | Where each copy layer's glyphs come from: `svg` traces the original letterforms exactly (best for plain, solid-color type); `font` typesets live, editable text in the nearest matching font (best when copy will be edited, resized, or localized). Both forms are always returned; the other is marked hidden. Options: `svg`, `font`. | `svg` |

## Response

``
{
  "request_id": "b47f2c1a-9e3d-4a6b-8c5f-2d1e9a7b4c30",
  "model": "bria-ads-delayer",
  "status": "queued",
  "created_at": 1772184500
}
``

## Check Request Status

### Endpoint

``
GET /api/v1/ie/requestqueue/apikey/requests/{request_id}
``

### Response

``
{
  "request_id": "b47f2c1a-9e3d-4a6b-8c5f-2d1e9a7b4c30",
  "model": "bria-ads-delayer",
  "status": "success",
  "outcome": {
    "layers_document": {
      "background": {
        "type": "background",
        "url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/gmi-generated-assets/.../background_plate.png"
      },
      "cutouts": [
        {
          "type": "product",
          "url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/gmi-generated-assets/.../product_cutout_0.png",
          "bbox": [120, 340, 610, 900]
        },
        {
          "type": "logo",
          "url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/gmi-generated-assets/.../logo_cutout_0.png",
          "bbox": [40, 40, 220, 130]
        }
      ],
      "text_layers": [
        {
          "content": "SUMMER SALE",
          "mode": "font",
          "font_family": "Helvetica Neue Bold",
          "hidden_mode": "svg",
          "svg_url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/gmi-generated-assets/.../text_0.svg",
          "bbox": [80, 150, 700, 260]
        }
      ],
      "vector_shapes": [
        {
          "type": "rectangle",
          "svg_url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/gmi-generated-assets/.../shape_0.svg",
          "bbox": [0, 0, 1080, 1080]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
``

## Request Status Values

| Status | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `queued` | Request is waiting in the queue |
| `processing` | Ad image is currently being decomposed |
| `success` | Layer decomposition completed |
| `failed` | Decomposition failed (check logs for details) |
| `cancelled` | Request was manually cancelled |

## Pricing

* **Pricing Type**: Per request, flat rate
* **Price**: $0.30 per request
